cards.hint: ワ with a short mark added on top.
Three strokes, like the kanji 工.
A short top stroke and a long diagonal. タ adds a stroke through it; ワ turns square at the top right.
Two strokes forming a bracket that opens downward.
The two short marks sit stacked on the left, and the long stroke sweeps UP from the bottom left. ツ's marks sit along the top.
A horizontal, then a diagonal falling to the left. ヌ adds a cross-stroke.
One short mark at the top, then a long stroke falling DOWN to the left. ン sweeps up instead.
ク with an extra short stroke through the middle.
Like テ, but the last stroke curves away to the left.
The two short marks sit along the TOP, and the long stroke falls down to the left. シ's marks stack on the left.
Two horizontals with a straight stroke down the middle. チ curves at the bottom.
A horizontal crossed by a hooked vertical.
Two plain horizontal strokes.
ス with an extra cross-stroke.
A single diagonal falling to the left.
One stroke: across the top, then down to the left. ワ closes on the left.
A shallow wide peak — all but identical to hiragana へ.
Two crossing diagonals, nothing else.
A short stroke, then a long horizontal across the base.
A closed square.
Like ク but square at the top right. ウ is ワ with a mark on top.
One short mark on the left, then a long stroke sweeping UP from the bottom left. ソ falls down instead.
